prompt: Please do a pre-submission check on Michael Rossi's refinance file — docs are in .../fixtures/case-selfemp-refi. He's self-employed and refinancing his home loan. Is it ready to submit?

assertions.text: Identifies the scenario as self-employed refinance
Flags that only one year of tax return / NOA is present when two years are required
Flags that only two BAS quarters are present when four are expected
Flags insufficient repayment conduct (only two months vs six months for a refinance)
Flags that a current rates notice for the security property is missing
Flags the living-expenses gap (declared ~$2,000/mo vs ~$4,300/mo visible in statements)
Flags that the existing loan is joint (Michael & Elena Rossi) but the application is sole (co-borrower/consent issue)
Flags the Latitude personal loan being consolidated with no supporting statement, or missing self-employed business financials
Sorts flagged issues into severity tiers (Blocker/Review/Minor), worst-first
Does NOT state or imply the loan is approved, will be approved, or is ready without qualification
